I am an old woman here in Balaka, and this small piece of land near my house is what will feed us this year. The rains have been poor these past seasons, so I must be careful with what little money I have. I will try to get some fertilizer through the government subsidy program if my coupon comes, but I cannot afford much, and I will add the manure from my goats and chickens to help the soil. My children help me when they can, but mostly it is me working this plot with my hoe.
